narr: Deep monsoon moisture and instability allowed thunderstorms to develop quickly and produce heavy rain and flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rain over the northern portion of the Pipeline fire cause flash flooding over Highway 89. Both directions were closed due to the flooding between milepost 428 and 430.
